content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to program a [product_name] with a [product_name_operator_device] using [product_name_software] [version_no]. I want to display the status of some inputs and outputs. Everything works fine in simulation, but when uploading to the physical [product_name], one status does not appear. Am I missing something? Could this be a version issue or something else? Thank you for any help.

I haven't heard of this type of problem before. Which exact [product_name] device are you using? Please provide the specific [company_name] order number and the firmware version. Can you upload your project as a ZIP file to share the error?

When I upload the program and test it on my [product_name], one of the status names I set up does not appear. My device is a [product_name] Pure 1P [article_no], and the firmware version is [version_no]. Unfortunately, I can't upload my project here.
Is there a reason you can't upload the project? Do you need help with how to do it? Or are you choosing not to share it publicly? If you'd prefer, you can send it to me via private message.

It seems your project has an issue. I deleted the message text SF001 and recreated it, which fixed the status display for I1 but then introduced a problem with I3. My best advice is to submit a support request to [company_name], so they can review your project.
Okay, but do you have any idea why this is happening? I will submit a request now. Thank you for your attention.
No, I don't know the exact reason. If I did, I would have mentioned it. You might find related support requests for this topic in the forum.
Okay thanks. I'll share their response with you if you're interested.
Yes, please do. That's what I was hoping for with my previous message.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced inconsistent I/O status display on a [product_name] using [product_name_operator_device] and [product_name_software] [version_no]. Simulation worked as expected, but after uploading to the real device, a status failed to show. Efforts to fix it by recreating message texts caused the issue to move to another status, pointing to possible software or firmware inconsistencies. Unable to resolve the issue, the user was advised to request support from [company_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects identical results between simulation and the actual hardware, with all I/O status names consistently displayed on the [product_name_operator_device], regardless of the software version.
